name: The Echo Hall
legend: # = wall, . = floor, P = player start, D = door slot (in the outer wall), C = chest, S = rest shrine
waves_note: Enemies arrive in waves: the next wave comes when 1 enemy (or none) is left.
artProps: Layout copied from keepers-hall. Theme and props from the hall-of-echoes draft room "mask-hall". A grand hall of mirrors and bells; a floating mask hangs in the middle, copying the student.
signs: Say a kind word to the mask.
